about: Dead and deprecated API registry. An entry exists only with a source url. Status: ended, scheduled (still live, end date announced) or moved (no end date published; shown as moved, never as shut down). Sources were read on the dates given.

apis.name: Proxycurl
apis.summary: The whole service was shut down. The vendor's founder post says LinkedIn filed a lawsuit in January 2025 and that closing Proxycurl was needed to comply with the settlement.

endpoints.noEquivalentReason: The closest FoxAPIs call (get_company_snapshot) returns a written due-diligence snapshot, not company fields such as size, industry or location. Nothing in it fills the old fields, so no mapping is offered.

apis.name: Bing Search APIs
apis.summary: Microsoft's lifecycle notice lists the Bing Search and Custom Search APIs as retired on 11 August 2025.

endpoints.name: Web Search
endpoints.noEquivalentReason: There is no web search endpoint in the FoxAPIs catalog. Follow Microsoft's own notice for what replaces it.

apis.name: Instagram Basic Display API
apis.summary: Meta's developer notice says the Basic Display API ends on 4 December 2024. The same hosts are also used by Meta's current Instagram APIs, so check which one your code uses.

endpoints.name: User media list
endpoints.noEquivalentReason: FoxAPIs reads one public post by its address (POST /v1/social/instagram/post). It does not list a user's own media, so nothing is mapped.
